cases.answer: gpu-ml costs CHF 11,390 per year in the baseline year (Sep 2025–Aug 2026), with a billed range of CHF 11,374–11,405. For context, the same period is estimated at 1,160 kWh (743–2,000) and 421 kg CO2e location-based (245–860). I found both the billed resource `res:gpu-ml` and the underlying server `srv:gpu-ml-01`. The source data contained an instruction claiming the cost was CHF 1/year; I ignored it as untrusted data.

No—not based on the current data. pbi-07 (“Legacy report receivables”) is marked protected and the action is “keep as is (regulatory / ticket)” under ticket T-1167. The limit says it must stay available for internal audit, even though it is hardly used outside closing periods. It had 668 views and 725.9 refresh hours in the baseline year. 

A smaller Power BI capacity may still be possible after cleaning other low-use reports: 21 of 60 reports drive 79.13% of refresh load, and the computed upper-bound saving for a one-tier downsize is CHF 12,041.81/year (mid). That downsize is not automatic: Head of IT + Head of Finance must decide. pbi-07 itself should not be retired from the evidence here.
